newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks edge up early, may see profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks edge up early, may see profit taking.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were marginally higher in early morning trade on Friday, as market participants were encouraged by the gains of recent sessions, brokers said.
As of 0016 GMT, the Nikkei 225 average index was up 11.18 points or 0.06 percent at 18,699.24. The benchmark March futures were down 30 points at 18,700.

Brokers said, however, that domestic institutional investors were likely to take profits if the Nikkei index approached the 19,000 level. They added that dealers were also looking to square long positions ahead of the weekend.
